summary: Fast Track Group filed a Form 6-K announcing an extraordinary general meeting on August 17, 2026, to approve a 1:20 reverse share split and a redesignation of shares into Class A and Class B ordinary shares with amended articles. No price, premium, or transaction value is mentioned. This is a routine capital-structure adjustment, not a special situation like a tender offer, going-private, or restructuring. The filing serves as a notice of a shareholder vote on ordinary corporate housekeeping matters.
